dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Malorua District, Shefa Province, Vanuatu as of 20 December 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20241217VUT, GDACS ID: 1458084** This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings and landslide extents resulting from the earthquake on December 17, 2024, in Vanuatu, as detected from a WorldView-2 very high-resolution satellite image acquired on December 20, 2024, at 09:46 local time. Within the analyzed area of approximately 3,000 hectares, UNOSAT identified 6 potentially damaged structures and 20 hectares of land affected by landslides. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
